column4: ~/proj/prompts/reports/SESSION-REVIEW-LEAVES-1.md item 2. Holds: case folding incl. Kelvin/Ohm/Angstrom signs, titlecase digraphs, capital sharp s (new pin internal/identity/review_leaves_test.go:TestNewFoldedName_FoldsCompatibilityCaseForms, red under an ASCII-only-folding mutation that every older test passes); both profiles reject zero-width space/joiners, word joiner, soft hyphen, variation selectors, tag characters, BOM, isolates and ALM (:TestNewFoldedName_RejectsInvisibleAndFormatRunes, red under a hand-rolled norm.NFC(strings.ToLower) mutation). Finding IDENTITY-FOLD-SPACE-WIDTH (low, open, NEEDS ANDREI ask identity-fold-space-width): FoldedName keeps NBSP/U+3000 and fullwidth forms and accepts leading/trailing/whitespace-only names, so ad min vs ad+NBSP+min, admin vs fullwidth admin, admin vs admin+space are distinct principals; reachable for usernames (core and HTTP check length only), role names (core checks length only) and SCIM group displayNames; no privilege effect (IsBuiltinRole/isAdminRoleName match exactly), display confusion in access review and audit. Not fixed here: changing the profile changes stored *_folded keys and normalize_backfill only fills empty columns, so it needs a re-fold migration with collision handling. Not covered: cross-script homoglyphs (Cyrillic a), out of scope for folding
